messages.subject: Adding covariates
parts:
Thank you very much for the nice and helpful package!
In MPlus it is possible to include covariates in the model. Is this possible with the tidyLPA package too?

Thank you!

messages.author: 3cfaef29dbc536f8
messages.subject: Re: Adding covariates
parts:
Hi, and thank you for your question. We do not provide functionality to include covariates - we recommend that these be carried out using MPlus. Our reasoning is that we want to keep the scope of tidyLPA narrow - and to only include functionality that can be carried out with both MPlus and mclust. 

Thank you for understanding!
Josh
